title: Cabbage Dragon and Witches
description: A vibrant green dragon with wings curled inside a large leafy cabbage at the center of the composition. Numerous small witches in green dresses and pointed hats fly in concentric circles around the dragon on broomsticks, set against a watercolor background with dark thorny branches at the bottom and outlined flowers at the top.
